title: Angular
description: Gates for an Angular project tested with Vitest through the Angular builder, ng test. Each tool comes from the repo's node_modules, so its version is the one the lockfile pins.

gates.description: Runs the unit tests in a watch kept warm between turns, since ng test builds the whole application before a single test runs. At the stop, it waits for the watch to finish with the turn's changes, then fails on a build that does not compile, and on every red spec, the ones the change did not rerun included. The whole check runs ng test once, without a watch.

watch.cycleEnd: Test run finished with success|bundle generation failed

gates.description: Builds the application in a watch kept warm between turns, which type-checks every template, the ones of a component no spec reaches included: tsc alone never reads a template. At the stop, it fails on a build that does not compile, with the file and line of each error. Built without optimization into node_modules/.cache, so the dist of the project stays as it is. The whole check builds once, without a watch.

Lints the changed templates with angular-eslint, warnings included: the lint of the TypeScript catalog reads no .html file. It needs an ESLint config that gives .html files to angular-eslint, such as its templateRecommended and templateAccessibility configs.
